name: Chicago Conservation Leadership Corps (CCLC)
org: Forest Preserves of Cook County with the Student Conservation Association
what_you_do: A paid summer crew job outdoors in the forest preserves. Teens build trails, spread mulch around trees and pull invasive plants, with adult crew leaders. There are also nature lessons and outdoor fun.
who_can_apply: Ages 15 to 19. You must be in high school or a recent graduate. You must be able to do hard physical work in summer heat and work on a team.
pay_detail: $15 an hour for high school members.
duration: 5 weeks starting in late June, 26 hours a week, Monday to Thursday
deadline_text: Youth applications are due in April each year. The page gives no exact 2027 date.
how_to_apply: Apply through the Student Conservation Association job site linked from the Forest Preserves page. Watch the SCA Chicago page for the 2027 opening.
notes: Rides to work sites leave from central pickup spots such as CTA train or bus stops. The SCA Chicago page still said its summer season was closed when read on 2026-10-16. Illinois requires an employment certificate for workers under 16, so 15 year olds should ask their school. SCA Chicago contact: (312) 239-1661 ext. 6009.
